w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: The Redactor stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Roberto just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w5Mentions.name: The Cancellation
w5Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Cancellation is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
firstContext: 🍖 FEAST 📺 — Henrik opens the pantry wide: 24× Blackberry. Desmond, Ines eat until the fire burns low. Somebody laughs so hard they cry. w5Mentions.name: The Spoiler
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Spoiler.
firstContext: 💛 You hold Knife roll. The dinner rush, the pass, the tickets coming faster than thought. You survived your first Saturday service at sixteen. The roll was the prize. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they know your hands. The feast was the weapon.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "The Big Beast." The Codex keeps it.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (15/6/5), with 8 wave-4 and 3 wave-5 fought, 8 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 16 · Craft 11 · Talk 16 · Explore 32 → 24 · capped)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TOTAL — COLD, CLEAN, EFFICIENT. YOU WOULD MAKE A MAGNIFICENT MACHINE. I MEAN THAT AS THE HIGHEST COMPLIMENT AND SLIGHTLY AS A THREAT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The dark road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE RELAY — "Merge fully. No way back."

◈ OUTSHONE — Roberto Feng did what you would not: acted, boldly, while there was still time. The village thrives. The god is someone else. The record notes, kindly and accurately, that you watched. It stings exactly as much as it should.
